name: Everlight Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Everlight Electronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of light-emitting diode (LED) in Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through LED, LCD, Illumination, and Other Department segments. It offers visible LEDs, including lighting, horticulture lighting, UV, flash, automotive, lamp, SMD, digital displays, backlight, and signage LEDs; infrared LEDs, such as silicon detectors, infrared receiver modules, optic fiber devices, and optical switches; ambient light, proximity, and color sensors; semi-power device, which includes SiC SBD, SiC MOSFET, and Si MOSFET; and photo couplers comprising photo transistors and darlington, schmitt …
